_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.

exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.chatPanel.gui.c: 845 -> 858 for one assertion inside the existing §12.2 disclosure case: the note box must sit at the same tight spacing as every other row, not a hole in the form (user report). It belongs with the toggle's own case, and a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots, so it cannot move without splitting the binary.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.menus.gui.cpp: 1638 -> 1766 for one case: the Stencil Script row as a flyout — its place under the Assistant, its four actions, typing through the menu's re-dispatch, and a run that edits the canvas with the menu still open. It belongs with the other context-menu cases, and a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots, so it cannot move without splitting the binary.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.menuKeys.gui.cp: 557 -> 619 for one case: the script flyout's keys — the two-step Right onto its editor, Tab indenting instead of walking the actions, and Ctrl+Enter running. Same binary rule as above.
exceptions.desktop/src/support: comment share was raised 21 -> 23 with no comment added: theme.cpp's 817-line QSS literal moved to resources/app.qss, so the directory lost that many non-comment lines from the denominator. Ratcheted back to 21 once the header bodies moved into .cpp TUs: the declarations left behind are comment-dense, the moved bodies are not, and both live in support/.
exceptions.desktop/src/llm: comment share was raised 20 -> 21 with no comment added: ChatPlanTarget.cpp, a 605-line low-comment file, moved to app/ where it belongs in the layer order, so llm/ lost those lines from the denominator. Back to 20 after the llm/ TU splits.
exceptions.desktop/tests: the MainWindow GUI e2e is one QtTest binary per feature area (MainWindow.<area>.gui.cpp). Each area is still far over 230 lines: a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots, so an area cannot be split further without splitting the binary again. The chat is four binaries for that reason — chatCards, chatCompact, chatDock and chatPanel/chatTurns — since one chat binary was longer than the whole rest of the suite run in parallel. The budget numbers above are the ratchet — drive them down as cases merge.
exceptions.desktop/src/app/MainWindow.hpp: 885 -> 890 for the script window: one QAction and three slots (open, the refresh a script shares with the toolbar, and the entry a dropped .stc uses). moc runs on this header, so a MainWindow member has nowhere else to be declared; the dialog, the core seam and the runner all live outside it. Back to 889 once the session draft went: the window opens empty. 889 -> 894 for the script FLYOUT: the panel action, the panel and its editor, plus ensureScriptMenuPanel — the context menu hosts the panel the way it hosts the chat one, and a MainWindow member has nowhere else to be declared. 894 -> 910: refreshDropHint(), since the canvas drop hint's keycaps are painted pictures a theme change must rebuild, and the Open-Image crop rect carried into the open path — a `cropRect` parameter on both openImage overloads and the pending-open struct's own `rect`. Same rule: moc runs here.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.toolbar.gui.cpp: 1569 -> 1622 for one case: the script button's place in DATA, its image gate and its chord. It belongs with the toolbar's other section-order cases, and a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots, so it cannot move without splitting the binary.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.chatDock.gui.cp: 864 -> 917 for one case: the compact popover refuses every title-bar drag — the press, the move past the start distance and the double-click all leave its geometry alone, and the same gesture moves it again once it leaves compact, which is the half that would strand the panel undraggable if the flag ever failed to clear.
exceptions.desktop/tests/LlmClient.headless.cpp: 933 -> 944: the default provider is no longer ollama (llmSettings.hpp ships "none"), so every ollama-path case that used to get it from the LlmSettings default now states it explicitly via the ollamaCfg() helper added here — one call site per case, already the most compact form.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.theme.gui.cpp: 935 -> 978 for one case: the canvas drop hint's keycaps — that they are drawn, that a Mac's paste cap is Command, that a theme change repaints pictures QSS cannot restyle, and that the sentence stays centred beside caps taller than itself. It belongs with the other palette cases, and a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots.
exceptions.desktop/tests/MainWindow.projects.gui.cp: 1013 -> 1019 for one assertion inside the existing pinned-row case: the dialog rebuilds more than once on its way up, so a row nobody has seen yet must not form out of particles as though it had just been created. It belongs with that case's own pinned row, and a QtTest binary runs one QObject of slots.
exceptions.desktop/src/dialogs: comment share 10 -> 11 with comments ADDED, not code removed: this run of Open-Image fixes each turned on a Qt behaviour that cost real debugging and is invisible in the code — deleteLater leaves a live child past the next measure, a child born into a shown parent stays hidden and drops out of the layout's hint, resize() is clamped by the layout minimum AND the minimum already propagated to the window, overRect refuses an invisible source, and a QCheckBox cannot wrap so its label becomes the row's minimum width. Roughly fifteen other comment lines in this directory were tightened to hold 10 before this; the remaining ones are the invariants. Ratchet it back as these TUs split.
exceptions.desktop/src/dialogs/OpenImageDialogSizeD: first tracked at 272 (over the 230 new-file cap, but not a new file — split out of OpenImageDialogDust.cpp earlier this session): the Custom W×H group now forms and falls with its own cloud on the SAME keyword-chip recipe as the page-size row beside it (cropSizeCustomDust/slideCropSizeCustom, mirroring cropSizeRowDust/slideCropSizeRow field for field) — picking Custom, or leaving it, used to be a plain setVisible with no motion of its own (user report; browser twin: openImageModal.js's syncCropSizeCustom).
